intro.heading: ABOUT ME
intro.body: I'm Muhammad Ahmed Ashar, a web developer based in Karachi. I turn ideas into websites and applications, with close attention to how they look, how they work and how people use them.

approach.heading: APPROACH
approach.body: Good design helps people understand where they are, what they can do and what happens next.
approach.caption: A principle behind my work.

about.heading: I care about how it works, and how it feels to use.
paragraphs: I'm Muhammad Ahmed Ashar, a web developer based in Karachi. My work brings together development and a background in graphic design, so I think about the interface and the code behind it as parts of the same job.

Before choosing a platform or writing code, I want to understand what you're trying to do, who it's for and how it will be used. Those questions shape the layout, the features and the tools I work with.

I build websites, online stores and web applications. Some projects call for custom development; others need a platform that makes everyday updates straightforward. I work with both, choosing the approach around the project and the people who will manage it.

Working on logos, layouts and UI mockups has taught me to pay attention to the small decisions: how content is arranged, where the eye goes and whether an interaction feels clear. I bring that same attention to development.

I studied MERN stack development at Saylani Mass IT Training and completed a three-year diploma in Computer Information Technology. My toolkit includes custom development and CMS platforms, with the specific tools listed below.
Outside of work, I'm a Hafiz-e-Quran. The focus and consistency that took are still part of how I learn and work. I also enjoy sketching ideas and tinkering with custom keyboards.
about.closing: The details matter, from the first layout to the final interaction.
